name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Judge blocks Trump's latest effort to narrow birthright citizenship
changes.summary: A federal judge has temporarily blocked a Trump executive order that would prevent certain people from automatically becoming U.S. citizens at birth.

changes.title: In Small Iranian Town, a U.S. Attack Turns a Wedding Into a Tragedy
changes.summary: The bomb that hit the residential area was American, according to a weapons expert and a visual analysis by The Times. It killed five people and wounded 67 others, the Iranian authorities said.

changes.title: Inside the Fight Against a Flesh-Eating Fly in Mexico
changes.summary: For the first time in a year, the U.S.-Mexico border partly reopened to cattle imports following a screwworm infestation across the region. The battle against the flesh-eating fly has only just begun deep in Mexico.

changes.title: Iran war ramps up again amid series of resignations and firings in U.S. military
changes.summary: Strikes between the U.S. and Iran are ratcheting back up amid an important resignation in the U.S. military. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean reports.

changes.title: Iran fires on its Gulf neighbors, retaliating for U.S. strikes after a wedding was hit
changes.summary: Iran fired on U.S. allies in the Gulf early Wednesday following a night of American bombardment that Iranian officials say included a deadly strike on a wedding party.

changes.title: Chevron Expansion in Venezuela Extends U.S. Influence Over Oil Riches
changes.summary: The U.S. energy giant, which stayed in the country after other Western companies left, will invest $7 billion in the country to more than double its production there.

changes.title: Bessent says China agrees Iran shouldn't have nuclear weapons
changes.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that China and the U.S. are on the same page regarding Iran having nuclear weapons. CBS News' Aaron MacLean reports.

changes.title: Iran claims U.S. struck wedding party as Trump navigates Pentagon leadership infighting
changes.summary: Iran is making fresh claims about the latest round of strikes in the region. This comes as U.S. military leaders navigate tensions sparked by resignations and recent firings. CBS News' Eleanor Watson has more.

changes.title: Judge lacked power to overturn ex-soldier Bowe Bergdahl's military conviction, appeals court rules
changes.summary: A three-judge panel from the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit on Tuesday ordered the dismissal of Bergdahl's claims in district court.

changes.title: Heads or tails? $1 coin with Trump's face and gold finish go on sale
changes.summary: The coin's design — Trump's visage as "heads" and the Great Seal of the United States as "tails" — was given the stamp of approval this year by the U.S. Commission of Fine Arts, whose members Trump appointed.
